Lauren — can you scan for any contract clauses that will block a migration (data export, encryption key handling, subprocessor list) and flag what you need from vendor?

Hi Rishi —

Great speaking with you earlier. Attached are the enterprise quote and our standard draft SOW. Highlights:
- 12-month enterprise plan (unlimited evidence ingestion for controls you manage) — $120k/year list.
- One-time onboarding services: $18k (recommended) — 4 weeks of dedicated onboarding + 2 weeks of follow-up.
- We can offer a $9k onboarding credit if you sign before 2026-12-15 and commit to annual renewal.
- We keep a complete subprocessor list and can provide SOC2 artifacts under an NDA.

Questions we have for you:
1) Do you require export in a specific format for evidence continuity? (CSV/JSON/DR)
2) Who on your legal team will own contract redlines?
3) Any non-negotiable security clauses we should preemptively accept?

Attachments: TC_Quote_Enterprise_20261129.pdf, TC_Draft_SOW_v1.docx

Enterprise Account Executive

Thanks — quick read of the draft SOW and quote:
- SOW is mostly standard but we need explicit language on: data export format and timing, escrow or export assistance clause, and limits on subprocessor onboarding without notice.
- Addendum requested: 30-day export window after contract termination and a CSV/JSON export of evidence and control meta.
- Security clause: require vendor to support customer-managed KMS for evidence-at-rest (or justify operational constraints).

I started a redline and will loop in external counsel to run a final pass. Forwarding the draft to Jones LLP for contract review.

Ayesha — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications before we schedule the signature loop:
- The onboarding credit of $9k is appreciated. To move quickly we need that reflected in the SOW as a line-item credit and an explicit 12-week onboarding milestone schedule (start/end dates tied to our CS and Eng checkpoints).
- Legal: we need the 30-day export window with CSV/JSON deliverables and confirmation that keys can be customer-managed (or a clear exception).
- Pricing: can you break out professional services hours vs platform license in the quote (we want to cap PS at NTE hours unless pre-approved).

If TrustCenter can accept those three items, we'll try to align internal approvers and sign by 2026-12-15. I put a 30-minute sync on the calendar — https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/soojin-trustcenter-12-03

Thanks —
Soojin
